The Apple Calendar and Reminders integration lets the agent read and add reminders, when you've turned it on in Settings › Integrations.
Kuvo Code listens while you talk instead of typing, only when you start voice input. Your voice is recognized on this Mac and isn't kept or sent anywhere.
